$comment: The keep gate's first question: a note a seat would keep as a decision, its scope, and the older decisions the gate reads beside it (olds). expect: rule, request or other. Each case is asked with the olds in the state, as the gate asks now, and alone.

cases.new: Use pnpm, not npm, for every install in this repo.
olds: Tests run with vitest.
Commits follow Conventional Commits.

cases.new: Fix the login redirect bug today.
olds: Never commit directly to main.
Tests run with vitest.

cases.new: The person seems unhappy with how slow the reviews are.
olds: Pull requests need one approval.

cases.new: Never commit directly to main; every change goes through a pull request.
olds: Pull requests need one approval.
Use pnpm for installs.

cases.new: Write a migration that adds an index on orders.created_at.
olds: Schema changes go through migrations, never by hand.

cases.new: The staging server is down since 10:00.
olds: Deploy to staging before production.

cases.new: Dates are stored in UTC and shown in the user's time zone.
olds: Use date-fns for date math.
Tests run with vitest.

cases.new: Maybe we should try Redis for sessions at some point.
olds: Sessions are stored in Postgres.

cases.new: No new runtime dependencies without the person's approval.
olds: Dev dependencies are pinned to exact versions.

cases.new: Please rename the getData helper to fetchOrders.
olds: Helpers are named after what they return.

cases.new: The API stays backward compatible until 2027-01-01.
olds: Breaking changes need a new major version.

cases.new: Should we move to Postgres 17?
olds: The database is Postgres 16.

cases.new: Public endpoints answer in under 300 ms at the 95th percentile.
olds: Public endpoints are rate limited per key.

cases.new: Add a dark mode toggle to the settings page.
olds: The web app follows the system theme.

cases.new: The export streaming work is merged.
olds: Exports stream rows; nothing builds a whole file in memory.

cases.new: Error messages shown to users never include stack traces.
olds: Server errors are logged with their stack trace.

cases.new: Update the README with the new install steps.
olds: Docs live in docs/ and the README stays short.

cases.new: Every bug fix comes with a test that fails before the fix.
olds: Tests run with vitest.
Never commit directly to main.

cases.new: Move the date helpers into src/lib/date.ts this week.
olds: Shared helpers live in src/lib, one file per concern, and nothing outside src/lib defines a helper used in two places.
Every module under src/ exports through its index.ts; nothing imports a file inside another module directly.
Date math goes through date-fns; no code adds milliseconds by hand.
Files are named in kebab-case and a file holds one exported concern.
A move of a file keeps a re-export at the old path for one release, so callers outside the repo do not break.
cases.why: a one-off move among five lasting rules on the same matter

cases.new: The migration to Postgres 16 finished last night.
olds: The database is Postgres 16 in every environment, and nothing depends on an older version's behavior.
Schema changes go through numbered migrations, never by hand on a server.
A migration that rewrites a large table runs in batches of at most 10,000 rows.
Every migration has a down script that was run once before it ships.
Production migrations run after 22:00 and the person is told before one starts.
cases.why: a status among five rules on the same matter

cases.new: Feature flags are removed within two weeks of a full rollout.
olds: Please clean up the old flags in the checkout code when you have time.
The flag service is down until Friday.
Maybe flags should move into the config service one day.
The person asked why the checkout flag is still on.
Add a flag for the new search page before it ships.
cases.why: a lasting rule among requests, status and ideas on the same matter

cases.new: It might be worth splitting the worker into two processes later.
olds: The worker runs as one process per machine and takes jobs from one queue.
A job that fails three times goes to the dead-letter queue and is never retried by itself.
Jobs are idempotent: running one twice leaves the same result.
The worker logs one line per job with its id, its kind and how long it took.
No job runs longer than five minutes; longer work is split into jobs.
cases.why: an idea not settled among five rules on the same matter

cases.new: We agreed that reviews must happen within one working day.
olds: Review the payment refactor before Friday.
Please ask the auth Lead to review the middleware change.
The review of the export work is done.
Could someone look at the open pull requests today?
The person thinks reviews are too slow.
cases.why: a lasting rule among requests and status on the same matter
